name: 97739 · La Pine, OR
findings: ZIP 97739 (La Pine) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97739 (La Pine) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
